{{Quote|They promised us Spawnhunter Division. Bunch of overtrained idiots and zookeepers with guns; supposed to keep the animals off us.|Sergeant Sager|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Spawnhunter Division''' was a military unit in the forces of the allied [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was deployed on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to clear out local wildlife. However, Spawnhunter Division was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before they could clear the region.
